title: Earthquake Shaking Potential for California — Fine Translation Refinement
warnings: This run composes the corrected 21-point affine alignment with a second-order translation fitted to three geographically separated schema-v2 reference-to-source arrows.
The three-point correction is insufficient for a held-out affine or projective fit; those models were explicitly not evaluated.
The selected translation has 1.60-pixel leave-one-out median and 2.80-pixel maximum residual.
Each Modified Mercalli legend row is sampled as a range of color prototypes so hillshade/gradient variation is not mistaken for a new semantic class.
Pixels too close to two adjacent intensity ranges remain NoData.
This is an ordinal six-class interpretation of the legend, not a claim that a continuous physical measurement was recovered.
